title: Detailed drum
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shell" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e84a2f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b52a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="head" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff4d6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8cfa0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rim" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd95e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d4a017"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="shellH" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b4a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d43a20"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow under drum -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="89" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#3a2a2a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- drum body (cylinder shell) -->
  <rect x="26" y="42" width="48" height="38" rx="1" fill="url(#shell)"/>

  <!-- vertical stripes / tension rods on shell -->
  <rect x="24" y="42" width="5" height="38" fill="url(#shellH)" rx="2"/>
  <rect x="71" y="42" width="5" height="38" fill="url(#shellH)" rx="2"/>

  <!-- drum bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="26" ry="8" fill="url(#rim)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="24" ry="7" fill="#b52a1a"/>

  <!-- drum body front -->
  <rect x="27" y="43" width="46" height="36" fill="url(#shell)"/>

  <!-- top rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="26" ry="9" fill="url(#rim)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="23" ry="7.5" fill="#d4a017"/>

  <!-- drum head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="21" ry="6.5" fill="url(#head)"/>

  <!-- drum head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="41" rx="10" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- lugs / tension hardware around top -->
  <rect x="30" y="37" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <rect x="45" y="34" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <rect x="60" y="37" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <rect x="66" y="42" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <rect x="29" y="51" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>
  <rect x="67" y="53" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#ffe27a"/>

  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1="18" y1="28" x2="55" y2="46" stroke="#c49a5a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="28" r="3" fill="#f0d69a"/>

  <line x1="82" y1="26" x2="48" y2="45" stroke="#c49a5a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="26" r="3" fill="#f0d69a"/>
</svg>
